## Accessibility checklist

- [ ] I used semantic HTML before ARIA.
- [ ] I completed the flow with a keyboard and checked visible focus.
- [ ] The change does not rely on sound, colour or motion alone.
- [ ] I checked captions, transcript and sign-video presentation when relevant.
- [ ] I checked zoom/reflow and reduced motion.
- [ ] Automated accessibility checks have no new serious or critical violations.
- [ ] Public behaviour and known limitations are documented.
- [ ] Major Deaf/ISL UX changes received relevant community review or are clearly marked as awaiting review.

## Release

- [ ] Tests and type checks pass.
- [ ] Documentation is updated.
- [ ] A Changeset is included, or this change does not affect a public package.
